item.title: Bitter Englishman
item.description: Bitter Englishman John Lally is effing pissed. The English superfan and unfortunate Everton supporter always has a hot take on football and his rants are as entertaining as they are insightful. Whether it’s VAR, annoying fans, or his poor Toffees losing yet again, Lally is eternally ticked off about something. And don’t get him started on whether to call it soccer or football. eighteencdm Tue, 6 Jan 2026 - 13:12

item.title: Fueling Champions
item.description: Fueling Champions Join us on an incredible journey with Chef Teren Green, the renowned chef behind the U.S. Women's National Team's success in the 2019 World Cup. From France to fueling champions, Chef T's story is one of passion, teamwork, and creating protein-rich recipes for athletes. Discover the integral role Chef Teren Green played as the team's chef, how peanuts take center stage in his recipes for athletes, and explore his culinary philosophy focused on clean, nutrient-dense ingredients.
